name: 14770-longcontext-dsv2lite16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One process, one GPU, the in-process backend.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, hidden 2048, bf16, vocab 102400; multi-head latent attention; MoE with 64 routed + 2 shared experts, 6 routed active per token; 15.7 B total / ~2.4 B active.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, bounded at 128 requests / 3600 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion, so ~102 requests are measured.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. Prompt exactly 32000 tokens and output exactly 1000 (min = max on both), with `ignore_eos` so every request emits all 1000. `request_format: plain` and `temperature: 0.0` target the raw completions endpoint. Prompts are Faker-generated synthetic English.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant summarizing 32,000-token reports into page-long answers for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments. The interpreter and the hardware seal live in configs/env.yaml, which is this
# machine's and is NOT portable.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# HAZARD, not a preference. This checkpoint declares a custom config class
# (`auto_map.AutoConfig = configuration_deepseek.DeepseekV2Config`) and transformers has no
# built-in `deepseek_v2` config, so AutoConfig cannot resolve it without this.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
enable-prefix-caching: false

# PINNED, AND LOAD-BEARING -- do not drop these as "the defaults". The engine is built through the
# async path, whose usage context is not in `_set_default_args`' per-context table at this version,
# so an unpinned run falls through to the library defaults and sizes the batch differently from a
# real `vllm serve`.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 64

enable-chunked-prefill: true

# 32000 prompt + 1000 output is the worst case; 33792 is the next multiple of 256 above it. The
# checkpoint would otherwise offer 163840.
max-model-len: 33792

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.55
